tech_tips.title: Stop Murdering Your Database: Solve the N+1 Query Problem in Laravel
tech_tips.summary: How a single missing ->with() statement turns 1 database query into 100, slowing your e-commerce product catalog from 250ms to 4.2 seconds.
tech_tips.explanation: Eager loading with Eloquent's with() method pre-fetches relationships in a single optimized IN() query. For a boutique catalog with 50 products, this cuts database execution time by 88% and prevents server CPU spikes during flash sales.

tech_tips.title: Sub-100ms Page Loads in Laravel with Intelligent Redis Caching
tech_tips.summary: Deliver instant luxury storefront browsing by caching heavy relational data in RAM while keeping inventory updates synchronized in real time.
tech_tips.explanation: By caching parsed models in Redis, your server bypasses SQL parsing entirely. Response time drops from 480ms to 28ms, making mobile catalog browsing feel like a native iOS application.

tech_tips.title: Zero Layout Shifts: Automated Next-Gen Image Serving with Laravel & Tailwind
tech_tips.summary: Serve 40KB ultra-crisp AVIF images to modern smartphones instead of 2.8MB raw JPEGs, ensuring perfect Google Core Web Vitals.
tech_tips.explanation: Combining strict aspect-ratio utility classes with next-gen AVIF compression cuts image payload by 82% while locking the layout box in place before the asset finishes loading, guaranteeing a 0.00 CLS score.

tech_tips.title: Eliminate 250KB of Client JS: Next.js 15 Server Components (RSC)
tech_tips.summary: Keep your client bundles featherlight by fetching data and rendering markup directly on the server without shipping JavaScript to the browser.
tech_tips.explanation: By keeping database access in Server Components, client browsers download zero JavaScript runtime for catalog displays, yielding instantaneous First Contentful Paint and 100/100 Core Web Vitals.

tech_tips.title: Non-Blocking Webhooks with Python FastAPI & BackgroundTasks
tech_tips.summary: Respond to incoming webhooks and CRM alerts in 12 milliseconds while processing lead enrichments asynchronously in the background.
tech_tips.explanation: FastAPI's built-in BackgroundTasks dispatches heavy HTTP integrations or scraper tasks without blocking the ASGI event loop, guaranteeing sub-20ms webhook responses.
